provisional_contract.optional_logits: pre-penalty FP32 raw score, four values per 128-bit beat
provisional_contract.output_crc: IEEE CRC32 over little-endian selected_token and selected_score_bits
provisional_contract.note: Local ABI 2 and common flags/performance semantics are implemented. Global generated header/enums/instance/address/timeout mapping remain pending architecture freeze; revised RTL has no new board test.

flags_contract.bit3: STRICT_CHECK; software M03 checks remain required

performance_contract.cycles_compute: zero until a trusted activity signal is available
performance_contract.read_write_beats: sum native AXI RVALID/RREADY and WVALID/WREADY handshakes across all four masters
performance_contract.m14_specific_diagnostics: logical/modeled values gated by ENABLE_PERF; not replacements for common counters

implementation.scope: historical r1 full independent single-module BD post-route; revised flags/performance candidate has not been implemented

known_limitations: Public ABI enum/header, instance id, address assignment and timeout class pending architecture freeze
Historical r1 board acceptance predates the aligned flags/performance RTL; the revised candidate has not been board-tested
Input trace is historical FP16 converted to BF16; native M06 V2 BF16 trace pending
Prefill T=36/64 upstream last-row selection and integrated path pending
M03 must enforce range/capacity/layout/owner/generation/alias; boundary address tests pending
Internal AXI counters do not replace external HP2 APM; external monitor pending
No PL DDR/MIG in independent image; full system integration pending
Numeric bit-exact guarantee scoped to archived finite trace and tool version; extreme/subnormal matrix pending
